frequency_question: Among major bilateral resource treaties reaching their expiration date after 20-40 years, how often are they formally renewed or extended rather than lapsing?
membership_rule: Includes signed bilateral treaties concerning shared river basins or water resources with fixed multi-decade durations that reach their terminal year. Excludes non-binding declarations and internal domestic water agreements.
window: Within the final 12 months preceding expiration or up to the expiration date

cases.name: Lesotho Highlands Water Project Phase agreements
Soviet-era boundary and water pacts adopted by successor states in Central Asia

provenance_note: 5 cases named, 6 claimed via skeleton x multiplier
coverage_note: 5 named major instances; believed roughly 6 in total globally for this class of long-duration water treaties over recent decades
known_gaps: Excludes minor local municipal cross-border agreements which have higher churn rates.
skeleton: Global bilateral transboundary water treaties reaching expiry milestones
multiplier: 5 historical or long-standing framework renewals observed out of 6 major instances where renewal was formally due
validity_reason: Treaty renewal norms and international legal frameworks for water sharing change slowly over multi-decade periods.
